# ETF Trading

> Independent, plain-English guide to ETF trading for investors worldwide (US, UK, EU, Australia): what ETFs are, how to buy and sell them, real costs, platforms, strategies, taxes and risks.

## Main guide
- [ETF Trading — complete guide](https://etftrading.github.io/): definition, 5-step start, platform comparison, costs and fee calculator, ETF types, strategies, returns, trading hours and order types, risks, taxes, popular ETFs, FAQ.

## ETF guides (each with a free calculator)
- [Gold ETF Trading](https://etftrading.github.io/gold-etf-trading/): GLD vs IAU vs GLDM by fees, plus a cost calculator
- [Silver ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/silver-etf/): SLV vs SIVR vs PSLV by fees, plus a cost calculator
- [Bitcoin ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/bitcoin-etf/): IBIT, FBTC, GBTC fees + ETF vs real bitcoin calculator
- [XRP ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/xrp-etf/): All 5 spot XRP ETFs + Solana staking ETFs compared
- [S&P 500 ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/sp500-etf/): VOO vs SPY vs IVV vs SPYM, with a 30-year fee calculator
- [QQQ ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/qqq-etf/): QQQ vs QQQM vs TQQQ, Nasdaq-100 returns and fees
- [Dividend ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/dividend-etf/): SCHD, VYM, JEPI yields + monthly income calculator
- [Treasury ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/treasury-etf/): SGOV, BIL, TLT yields + after-tax savings comparison
- [Leveraged ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/leveraged-etf/): TQQQ, UPRO, SOXL explained + volatility decay calculator
- [TSLA ETF](https://etftrading.github.io/tsla-etf/): TSLL, TSLQ, TSLY and ETFs with the most Tesla
